paragraphs.text: The Obzedat (also known as the Ghost Council of Orzhova ) is the ruling body of the Orzhov Syndicate on Ravnica . They collectively serve as the guildmaster of the Orzhov, and the iteration of the council during the signing of the Guildpact was the guild's parun .

The Obzedat consisted of spirits of the former Orzhov patriarchs and matriarchs, who ascended to the immortal ghost level. These autocrats had maintained their wealth and power even as they had shed their mortal forms. They were also known as Deathless , as they had managed to cheat mortality, maintaining their consciousness (and their greed) beyond the threshold of death. Most of the Deathless appeared as morbidly obese high priests or nobles, but sickly, pale, and ghostly in form. The head of the council, who gave final approval to the Obzedat's decisions, was Grandfather Karlov , who had been dead for centuries. The other members of the latest composition of the council were Enezesku , Fautomni , " Uncle Karlov " , Vuliev and Xil Xaxosz .

The Ghost Council resided deep under the Orzhov district in the central Ravnica . It is possible that the founders of the Obzedat were the same Orzhov representatives who originally participated in the Signing of the Guildpact , or that they were replaced by others at that time. Membership in the Obzedat is granted for an excellent "performance" in life, but the entrance is subject to a probation period. The membership can also be canceled under exceptional conditions. The Obzedat rarely spoke directly with those outside the guild; instead, they communicated through the official Grand Envoy, Teysa Karlov .
The reign of the Obzedat ended when the planeswalker Kaya killed all members of the Council and took over as guildmaster . At that time, there had been about nine members in the council.
After the reigning guildmaster Teysa Karlov was murdered, her spirit assembled a new Ghost Council.

In the Echoverse , Niv-Mizzet was a spirit dragon and member of the Obzedat . Born thousands of years ago, Niv-Mizzet died in battle against the rampaging nephilim not long after Ravnica's decamillennial , leaving his hand-picked Izmagnus to run the Izzet guild in his absence. But Niv-Mizzet had cunningly planned for just such an eventuality. Through a series of cleverly concealed life-insurance policies purchased over millennia, he all but bankrupted the Orzhov Syndicate and bought himself a seat on the Ghost Council. One by one, the patriarchs' fortunes dwindled and were consumed, until Niv-Mizzet remained the council's sole member. Although his guild has changed, Niv still worked to protect all of Ravnica. No claw could be raised against him without raking its owner. Some accused him of fattening his coffers via his position as leader of both the Orzhov and, perhaps secretly, the Izzet. But he'd argue he was only taking a fair wage.
